label: Simplified substitute payment: ceiling while still employed
appliesTo: Employees still in the job, who meet the separate eligibility test for arrears owed by their current employer
why: Being still employed does not rule the scheme out, but it is a different door with a lower ceiling and its own conditions — including a wage test set against the minimum wage, which moves every January.

history.source: Ministry of Employment and Labour — Labour Portal, unpaid wage resolution routes
history.note: Wage-related ceiling for a claimant still in employment. Eligibility carries additional restrictions that the former-employee route does not, so the lower cap is not the only difference.
